adjudication.evidence: P1 (467–498) shows a sustained N/E shift with return: N drops ~5 mm and recovers by ~504; E rises ~10 mm and recovers by ~504. P2 (504–518) is a small, isolated step in E (~-1.5 mm) without opposing return—no sustained platform, likely noise or part of motion. P3 (518–520) is a single-point spike (N/E/U large offsets) with no persistence or return, inconsistent with temporary platform. Only P1 satisfies criteria: sustained offset + opposing return across same axes, interior observations stable. Missing indices (510, 519) do not disrupt P1’s closure. Thus, keep only P1 as genuine temporary platform.
